basis.scope: Read-only historical HFT/source-method fidelity and producer/consumer audit. No fit, prediction, provider action, source edit, score, or budget/grader mutation.

findings.finding: The only trainer-source delta is a two-line parser addition for --wsd-shape and its help text. The planned HFT uses the OneCycle default, as did the historical HFT provenance; no GCorr, mask, freeze, initialization, split, normalizer, or checkpoint behavior changed between these revisions.
findings.scientific_consequence: No consequential historical-versus-planned HFT implementation drift was found. The source delta does not block the fold-clean candidate.
findings.smallest_clarification: Consider adding --sched onecycle explicitly to the planned HFT argv/method record so a future default change cannot silently alter the recipe. Current behavior is already OneCycle.

findings.location: recipe.json stages.muon_parent, family_student, and gcorr_hft; actual historical provenance.json files
findings.finding: Checked method fields have zero mismatches between the reconstructed parent/student method declarations and their actual historical provenance. The Z4 parent is the declared 4-epoch hidden-Muon parent at ep3; the family student is its 2-epoch AdamW child at ep1 with alpha .7, raw family targets and weight .1. Historical parent/student seeds are 99; the prepared clean screen uses seed 3 deliberately, so this is a method comparison with new weights, not historical-weight recovery.
findings.scientific_consequence: The ancestry and stage settings are coherent; preserve the seed change and clean-fold membership as explicit treatment details.

findings.location: scripts/train_rnn.py clean campaign-split path and recipe.json folds 0/1
findings.finding: The pinned split manifests match their declared hashes. Fold 0 partitions 1,405 valid fit groups and 468 evaluation groups; fold 1 partitions 1,416 fit and 457 evaluation groups. Each pair is disjoint and covers all 1,873 valid groups. With --train-source valid, the trainer builds the fit pool by subtracting fold_groups; campaign_split.assert_fit_groups checks the final fit groups. --full-valid sizes the evaluation index and does not widen train_idx.
findings.scientific_consequence: The planned fold masks separate fit and scored groups as intended. These already inspected folds are robustness evidence, not a fresh holdout.

findings.location: scripts/make_core_checkpoint.py at fe8e248f8e25e789274716ca29e5ab60903857ae and actual historical seed-99 student/crop/HFT checkpoints
findings.finding: The actual student model_ep1 checkpoint has 31 rows in head.2.weight/bias; the actual crop model_ep1 has 23. The crop preserves the first 23 rows exactly and every other model-state tensor exactly, dropping only the eight family rows. The actual HFT initializes from that crop at @ep1, writes fixed ep0, keeps all 10 inp/gru state tensors and mean/std unchanged, and changes head tensors. The planned --freeze inp,gru prefixes match actual model-state names.
findings.scientific_consequence: The historical producer format and HFT consumer path agree with the reconstructed crop-and-finetune contract.

findings.finding: The matched same-fold/same-seed strong-T3 control run/checkpoint is not yet bound.
findings.scientific_consequence: This does not prevent fitting a valid candidate parent or its declared descendants; root must bind the control before comparative grading.

unchanged_method_flags: lr 0.0005, wd 0.01, batch 16, chunk 2000, fast path
intentional_cleanfold_changes: Historical HFT has valid_fold=-1 and eval_source=dev; the clean recipe binds fold-specific split manifests and eval_source=vfold.
The clean HFT trains on the fold's eligible valid groups, excluding its evaluation groups; historical HFT fit 1,505 valid groups without a clean-fold mask.
Historical parent/student use seed 99; the clean diagnostic uses seed 3 throughout its chain and must not be described as recovering the historical weights.
The clean HFT initializes from its own fold's newly produced family-student crop at @ep1; historical HFT uses its all-data crop @ep1.

trainer_semantics_checked.mask_weight: main_row_weights selects valid & scored rows when enabled; the GCorr objective receives those weights.
trainer_semantics_checked.freeze: The trainer freezes parameters whose names begin inp or gru; actual crop/HFT states use those prefixes and the historical frozen tensors are unchanged.
trainer_semantics_checked.fold_mask: valid fit groups are set-differenced from the campaign evaluation fold and then checked by campaign_split.assert_fit_groups.
trainer_semantics_checked.normalizer: HFT inherits its crop initialization preprocessing; actual mean/std tensors are identical across historical crop and HFT.
trainer_semantics_checked.checkpoint_path: @ep1 resolves to model_ep1.pt; the crop produces model_ep1.pt and HFT selects model_ep0.pt.

actual_checkpoint_checks.load_method: CPU weights-only load with the checkpoint's TorchVersion type explicitly allowlisted; no unsafe pickle load or GPU initialization.
actual_checkpoint_checks.observations: 31->23 output-row crop verified; other model tensors preserved. Historical HFT init provenance binds the crop SHA; 10 inp/gru tensors plus mean/std match exactly, while head tensors changed.

limitations: This is source/recipe and actual small-checkpoint fidelity review only; no new candidate was fit, scored, or promoted.
The live GPU/quota/provider admission remains root-owned.
